item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 5 production call sites: two loop.py import/adapter uses of process_refine_name_batch, the pool adapter that wraps it, and the two remaining readers of the moved names on workers.py.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the module committed with its forwarders listed, a gate showing no added failures with the import checks passing, and the fragment carrying the moved symbols, forwarders, patch files and three size counts; the fragment carries all of these and logs/gate-head-default.log ends 318 passed EXIT=0, but the gate never ran tests/lint/test_fanout_confined_to_refine_name.py, which fails on the reviewed head and passes at the base.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to move the worker_refine_names symbols out of imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py per the design JSON; srtj-graph-ops-split-design.json inventories/workers.py/symbols maps exactly twelve symbols (two exception classes, three module constants, five classifiers, the scope-id helper and process_refine_name_batch) to worker_refine_names, and worker_tasks/worker_refine_names.py:34-40 and :156/:203 define the same twelve.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it records three commits, the twenty-file gate command, four gate logs plus a negative-control log, the size triple (250,123 to 214,485 bytes; 50,987 to 44,510 cl100k tokens; 71,463.71 to 61,281.43 gate units) and a retry_failures entry for the composer seam, but its outside_scope line names only test_refine_context.py and misses the lint test the move breaks.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff changes only imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py, imas_codex/standard_names/worker_tasks/worker_refine_names.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-workers-split-step18.html, all inside the three declared write paths, and no test file is touched.

justifications.durability: the node adds no assertions of its own, and the one guard that covers fan-out confinement in the moved worker, tests/lint/test_fanout_confined_to_refine_name.py:109, is left red rather than relocated to worker_refine_names.py; the forwarder mechanism itself is protected because every gate test patches the moved names through workers.process_refine_name_batch at workers.py:1021.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-base-graph.log and logs/gate-head-graph.log carry identical twelve-id failure sets and both default arms are green, but the chosen twenty-file set omits tests/lint/test_fanout_confined_to_refine_name.py, which passes at base and fails at head, so the recorded zero added failures measures the selection rather than the change.
justifications.fit: the forwarders at workers.py:981-1023 keep the one-line owner-naming docstring and the __wrapped__ facade established by steps 15-17, with every __wrapped__ assigned at workers.py:5198-5213 before the signature-stripping loop at workers.py:6025.
justifications.goal_fidelity: worker_tasks/worker_refine_names.py:156 and :203 take the resolver as a positional-only parameter and the module imports no sibling task module, matching the design's twelve-symbol map for worker_refine_names.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing _worker_dependency resolver owned at workers.py:59 and the division-into-worker_tasks layout owned by worker_common.py; it introduces no second resolver, no services slot and no duplicated capability, and all nine collaborators the moved body resolves exist in workers' globals.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 30ad34106 bddd700e9 lists only the three declared write paths, and no test or figure path is touched.
